Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a seeking <arc/>Arc Wave.

Lightning Seeker Properties:
• Aggresively tracks the closest enemy within a 32 meter radius, dealing <pve 1634 /> <pvp [Death] /> damage and applying <arc/>Jolt
• Additionally chains to 4 additional targets within a 10 meter radius on hit, dealing 65 damage
